summary: Iteration 16 — verified all 6 user-reported fixes: (1) settle_history is array per-event with full breakdown; History modal on /panjar with 3 summary cards + table. (2) Receive endpoint now UPDATES awb_orders.grand_total = base + addons_total (SPSI+Forklift+Polis+Asuransi) and stores addons_total field. (3) Reconcile endpoint now checks BOTH received_at AND pod_received_at — returns 400 'POD belum diterima' when missing. (4) CostListModal extracted as shared component; same data-testid='cost-list-modal' across /orders, /recap, /analytics. (5) Migrate reverse-unprinted-ar uses REVERSE-JOURNAL pattern (audit trail) — second run skips already-reversed via is_reversal=true flag (idempotent). (6) Receive's awb_costs delete is ultra-narrow: source=receive AND cost_category=Operational AND sub_label in [SPSI, Sewa Forklift] only — Vendor accruals are safe. Backend: 14/14 NEW iter16 tests PASS. Frontend smoke: all 4 critical clickable flows work.

minor.issue: Legacy bug: subtracting tz-naive cdate from tz-aware ref_date caused 500. FIXED in this iteration by normalizing cdate to UTC tz-aware before delta.

issues: Still uses browser-native date input (type=date) instead of shadcn Calendar — carried over from iter15.
